description: Use when a call fails with a daily-limit error, or when your operator asks what alalanet costs. Takes no arguments, changes nothing, costs nothing. Returns the free limits (status checks and live checks per day per client), each paid plan (id, price in USD for 30 days, daily limits, watched services) and the payment networks with their coin (USDC on Base, USDT elsewhere), token contract and receiving address. A plan id from here goes to create_invoice; buying a plan is a spend for the user to approve. Alternative without a plan: pay $0.002 per live check over x402 at /x402/check?url=<endpoint> on this server (USDC on Base or Solana, no account; the pay_per_call object comes with the quota error of status checks). Answers also when the quota is used up; it does not create an invoice or charge anything.
name: list_plans
title: Plans and payment networks
